messages:
Maya (Design): Brainstorm: 'StripLite' — a single-row overview above the heatmap that shows p95 band + throughput ticks and two micro-actions (jump, pin). Primary goals: scanability and low visual weight. Thoughts?
Jon (Frontend): Love lower visual weight. Concern: interaction targets get tiny at narrow widths. Need fallback gestures.
Samir (Eng Runtime): We can emit 15s or 60s aggregates depending on range to balance cost. Expose resolution param.
Priya (Product): Ops use-case: find a spike, jump scrubber, and optionally pin for comparison. Keep actions discoverable.
Noelle (A11y): Accessibility must-haves: never hover-only, expose keyboardable controls, provide meaningful aria-labels. Also avoid color-only signals for severity.
Maya (Design): Proposal: show chevron icon (24px) that is both focusable and appears on hover; for touch, longpress reveals pin action.
Jon (Frontend): Longpress is ok for touch but we need keyboard alternative. Add an overflow menu item "Pin interval" that is reachable by Tab.
Noelle (A11y): Yes. Also provide an offscreen summary readout when focused: "p50 80ms, p95 320ms, throughput 180r/s, severity: warning".
Samir (Eng Runtime): We'll add severity tag computed server-side and include sampling_ratio when data is sampled. Default to sampled for ranges > 2h.
Priya (Product): Microcopy: use "Spike" instead of "Anomaly" in badges. Add severity text for clarity (e.g., "Spike — critical").
Maya (Design): Visual idea: gradient band for percentiles in compact mode, full lines in expanded mode. Toggle exposed in header.
Jon (Frontend): Implementation plan: render base as canvas for perf, overlay a light SVG layer for hit targets and focusable buttons. Will prototype.
Noelle (A11y): Canvas needs fallback: expose role="region" and aria-labelledby to a hidden text block with the summary. Also ensure focus ring meets 3:1 when compact.
hook-bot: Build: protos/striplite v1 -> staging queued for 2024-11-10T14:00Z :rocket:
Maya (Design): Action items: Jon prototypes canvas variant, Noelle writes A11y spec and example narration, Samir adds resolution param and severity in API, Priya will update PRD notes. I'll post a Figma by EOD.
Jon (Frontend): Will push a prototype branch and link it here when ready.
Samir (Eng Runtime): I'll return a sample JSON response for the endpoint for frontend to use.
Priya (Product): Thanks all, this should speed triage without adding noise.
